title: When the Machine Turns
author: Isandro Amberdale
blurb: Freya Sandoval, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
